aiAnalysis.summary:
This problem requires a post-order DFS to distinguish between returning a single-branch path to the parent and updating the global path sum split at the current node, while properly ignoring negative subtree contributions using `max(0, subtree_sum)`. 

Revisit this in two weeks to test your code against an all-negative node tree and confirm your logic handles arbitrary node-to-node paths rather than a simpler root-to-leaf path (noting that LeetCode actually rates this as a Hard problem).
